result.paraphrase: ADATA XPG SX6000 Pro PCIe M.2 2280 SSD, 512GB. Description: XPG SX6000 Pro is an internal PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 solid-state drive (SSD) with NVMe 1.3 support, HMB (Host Memory Buffer), and SLC caching. Its single-sided 2.15 mm-thick design makes it slimmer than standard M.2 SSDs, so it suits notebooks, small-form-factor desktops, and some ultrabooks. Read/write speeds reach up to 2100/1500 MB/s, with random performance up to 250K/240K IOPS. Uses 3D TLC NAND Flash and includes a 5-year warranty. 512GB
